miras_bror.beskrivning: Little Mira waits for her brother, who ran toward Wolfstead the night the demons came. Follow his trail through the forest and find what was left behind.

repliker.start: Have you seen my brother? He ran toward Wolfstead. He had new sandals. Will you look for him?
repliker.klar_ge: They're his. I knew it. Take the doll. He'd want someone to have it.
repliker.klar_behall: He's alive? I knew it! I'll go there one day.

spar_i_skogen.text: Find the child's sandal in the moss on the road to Wolfstead.

kolarkojan.text: Follow the tracks to the abandoned charcoal hut along the Wolf Trail.

sanningen.text: The boy's last traces lie in the hut. The Runaway's Sandals are beneath the floor, guarded by a Warg Brute (Champion).

tillbaka.text: Decide what Mira should be told.

ge_sandalerna.text: Give Mira the sandals and tell her the truth.

behall_och_ljug.text: Keep the sandals and tell her that her brother lives in Wolfstead.

benens_visk.beskrivning: The Whisperer says his brother's skull still lies in his old house in Wolfstead, whispering his name at night. He wants it back. Or does he?

repliker.start: My brother whispers. Every night. He's still in the house in Wolfstead. Bring him to me.
repliker.klar_ge: Silence. At last, silence. Thank you. Take the fingers. They no longer point at you.
repliker.klar_behall: He chose you. Do you hear him now? No. But you will.

benhuset.text: Find the Whisperer's old house in Wolfstead, where the bones lie sorted in heaps.

lyssna.text: Stand in the house after nightfall and listen. One of the skulls is whispering.

skallen.text: Take the skull. Two Rotting Corpses (unique minions) rise.

ge_skallen.text: Give the skull to the Whisperer.

behall_skallen.text: Keep the skull (it is part of the Bonewhisperer's Garb).

ulvhilds_pals.beskrivning: Ulvhild devoured Hedda's husband and Bror's son. Both want her pelt, for different reasons. Hedda for vengeance. Bror to bury his son in it.

repliker.start_hedda: Ulvhild ate my husband. I want her pelt on my wall.
repliker.start_bror: My boy lies somewhere in her den. I want to bury him in the thing that took him.
repliker.klar_hedda: There she hangs. Now I can sleep.
repliker.klar_bror: Thank you. He can rest now. Take the axe. I can't bear to look at it.

spar.text: Find the chains at the mouth of Ulvhild's Den near Wolfstead.

palsen.text: Take Ulvhild's Pelt (quest item) and find Bror's son's wolf-tooth necklace among the bones in the den.

ge_bror.text: Give the pelt and the necklace to Bror.

runornas_ristare.beskrivning: Ylva wants to know who carved the runes. Each runestone bears a small mark, visible only by moonlight. The marks lead to the crypt beneath the Bone King's Chapel.

repliker.start: No one remembers who carved the stones. But the stones remember. Look at them by moonlight, child.
repliker.klar_sanning: He snuffed it out himself? Then he's the one waiting down there. Then someone must light it again.
repliker.klar_skona: A hero, then. I knew it. The runes were made by someone brave.

markena.text: Examine the runestones at night. Each shows part of a sign: a chisel, an eye, a crack.

ylva_tolkar.text: Show the signs to Ylva. She recognizes the chapel's old symbol.

kryptan.text: Find the Runecarver's wall deep in the Chapel Crypt, behind the Bone King's throne.

mejseln.text: Take the chisel left beneath the wall and read the inscription about the Fourth Stone.

sanningen.text: Tell her everything, even that the Runecarver snuffed out the Fourth Stone himself.

skona.text: Tell her only of the chisel, and say the Runecarver died in battle.

gravvaktarnas_sista_strid.beskrivning: Ebbe is the last Gravewarden. His brothers fell in the crypt the night the dead rose, and their Chronicle was lost with them. He wants to know how they died.

repliker.start: My brothers fell down there. I heard them singing. Then nothing. Find out how they died.
repliker.klar_ebbe: They held. All of them. To the last man. Take the lid. It was our captain's.
repliker.klar_ingrid: My grandfather? He held the door? Then I will hold the gate.

gravasen.text: Find the body of the last Gravewarden on Barrow Ridge, a key clutched in his hand.

kryptan.text: Open the Gravewardens' chamber in the Chapel Crypt with the key. It is guarded by a Skeleton Guardian (Unique) who was once their captain.

valet.text: Decide who the Chronicle belongs to.

ge_ingrid.text: Give the Chronicle to Captain Ingrid, whose grandfather is named in it (if she is in the village; otherwise it is left in her guardhouse).

begrav_benkungen.beskrivning: Valdemar was a good chieftain before the crown took him. Ebbe wants him buried as a man. Sara wants his signet, for reasons of her own.

repliker.start: The crown rules him, not his own will. Bring him down, and let us bury a chieftain, not a monster.
repliker.klar_begrav: Rest, Valdemar. The village is yours again.
repliker.klar_signet: Wear it well. It weighed on him too.
repliker.klar_sara: You gave him to the bonereader? Then let him talk to her.

benkungen.text: Slay Valdemar the Bone King in the chapel.

signeten.text: Among his bones lies the Chieftain's Signet (a quest item until you choose).

graven.text: Carry his bones to the chieftain's grave in the graveyard and decide the signet's fate.

behall_signeten.text: Bury him, but keep the signet.

ge_sara.text: Give the bones and the signet to Sara Bonereader.

klockorna_under_vattnet.karna: Follow the tolling through the mist to the Sunken Church and learn why the Bog Queen holds the drowned. Choice: free Lova's husband, or let him guard the shore.

korpmoderns_sista_flykt.karna: The ravens lead the hero across the tidal paths to the Raven Isles, where the Raven Mother waits. Choice: kill her, or lift her curse so the ravens watch over Mistshore for the hero.

jarnmunkens_las.karna: Elias opened the door that should have kept the brothers in. Find the Iron Monk in the Iron Cloister and choose: kill him, or let Elias speak with him one last time.

martas_dotter.karna: Marta's daughter fled to Copperfell. The trail leads to the Mine Depths and a group portrait among webs and crystals. Choose what Marta is told.

den_fjarde_stenen.karna: Rask knows the cult is hunting the Fourth Stone. Sneak through the Catacombs of the Cult, unmask the Prophet of Ash, and find the map to the Rift's Floor.

pilgrimens_vag.karna: Follow the pilgrim's prayers carved in the trees along the Ash Road to the gates of Ashenhold and beyond. Choice: bury his staff, or carry it to the Burnt Cathedral.

ljuset_som_haller.karna: Why does the lighthouse keep the Blight at bay? The light is a runestone. Find where it came from, and defend the lighthouse when the Blightfather sends his congregation.

tand_stenen.karna: With the Runecarver's Chisel and the truth from the crypt, the hero descends to the Rift's Floor. Face the Extinguished. Choice: light the Fourth Stone and seal the Rift, or take its power (unlocks magic).
